q1b_table1.why: Table 1 counts complaints closed with an admin response, which the database does not publish, so the bases differ.

q1c.why: The database records the date the CFPB received the complaint and the date it sent it to the company. It records no date of company response, and no date a bureau received a dispute notice under 15 U.S.C. 1681i. A complaint to the CFPB is not by itself the dispute notice the statute counts from.
